flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8773/ then On ProofBench, load the sample spec, run CALIBRATE and wait for the results.
Then confirm the evidence pack section offers JSON and Markdown downloads and shows a spec SHA-256 and a pack integrity hash.

remark: click: Clicking LOAD SAMPLE SPEC button
click: Clicking CALIBRATE button to start specimen calibration
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the results to complete
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the results
analyze: the evidence pack section shows a pack integrity hash
assert: the evidence pack section offers JSON and Markdown downloads and shows a spec SH

summary:
Loaded the sample specification on ProofBench and ran CALIBRATE.
Waited for the calibration results to finish.
The Evidence Pack was available with download options for both JSON and Markdown, along with displayed Spec SHA-256 and pack integrity hashes.
one_liner: ran CALIBRATE on the sample specification on ProofBench
